refinance.note: Loans for €9,000 over 36 months, lowest total interest first. Lenders decide the rate offered; check eligibility.

assumptions: A debt’s rate is read as an APR (an effective annual rate); a mortgage rate as a nominal annual rate.
Repayments are level; where only the months remaining are given, the repayment is worked out from the balance and rate.
Fees and charges are not added.

Overpaying is compared with saving the same money over 37 months (the time the debt takes to clear now), in the savings product that earns the most after DIRT. The repayment freed when a debt clears early is not counted.
